name: About — open source + name explanation
description: Two cards finishing the About page: a 'GPL/no telemetry' callout and the Squilla / mantis-shrimp name explanation.

test_data.os_body: GPL-3.0. No telemetry. No CLA. No "open core" bait-and-switch. What's in the repo is the whole thing.
test_data.name_body: Squilla is the Latin genus of mantis shrimps — the fastest punchers in the animal kingdom (sub-millisecond strike) and possessing the most complex visual system on Earth (16 photoreceptor types vs. our 3). Extreme speed; multi-spectrum perception (for AI agents); a segmented body with specialized appendages (kernel + extensions). The metaphor wrote itself.
